recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. It restores the approved R6 MessageDefinition half of FHIR-39635 and prevents canonical SubscriptionTopic message events from being omitted from the event search surface.
issue_request: FHIR-39635 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It requested allowing SubscriptionTopic as a FHIR message event by updating MessageHeader.event[x] and MessageDefinition.event[x] to allow Coding, uri, and canonical(EventDefinition, SubscriptionTopic).
initial_application: Commit b06ee38f43 applied the issue together with FHIR-32750 by adding canonical targetProfiles for EventDefinition and SubscriptionTopic to MessageHeader.event[x] and a MessageDefinition StructureDefinition copy. MessageHeader remained correct, but later merge/cleanup history left MessageDefinition with only the older Coding and uri event types in the active source.
additional_context: MessageHeader and MessageDefinition are active InM resources in source/fhir.ini. INM minutes from 2023-11-07 confirm the approved harmonization as Coding|uri|canonical(EventDefinition|SubscriptionTopic), and the originating Zulip thread ties the change to subscription notification message triggers. FHIR-32750 was only background because it shared the historical implementation commit but addressed MessageDefinition.parent.
reconciliation: Changed the active MessageDefinition StructureDefinition source to add canonical targetProfiles for EventDefinition and SubscriptionTopic and updated the event[x] short/definition text. Also updated the active MessageDefinition-event search parameter expression to include canonical values, matching MessageHeader-event behavior.
source_changes: source/messagedefinition/structuredefinition-MessageDefinition.xml: restored canonical(EventDefinition,SubscriptionTopic) as an allowed MessageDefinition.event[x] type and updated the element short/definition.
source/messagedefinition/bundle-MessageDefinition-search-params.xml: included MessageDefinition.event.ofType(canonical) in the active event search parameter expression.

related_jiras.note: Implemented in the same historical commit, but it concerned removing MessageDefinition.parent and was not part of the SubscriptionTopic event decision.
